# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Titles:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>; master  <sub>[v1 c15 P12](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0012)</sub>; educator  <sub>[v1 c17 P18](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0018)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a mustache that he twirls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He is prone to showing off his authority and has a sarcasm that the children detest. He is easily distracted from his teaching duties by romantic pursuits, often spending class time clarifying coursework for older female students or scribbling notes. Despite his strict disciplinary actions toward some students, he can show leniency or ignore misconduct when preoccupied.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at the Brierley school. During his tenure, he spent significant time assisting Sukey Pullen with her studies and courting her, often neglecting the rest of his students. He punished Nell Harcourt by forcing her to stand on the dais after she broke a slate over Hugh Carrow's head for teasing her, and later forced her to sit beside Hugh when she arrived late from the spruce grove. After two years of teaching, he delivered a moving farewell address to the school and departed at the end of the June term.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
